summary: get_url options for unsafe_writes, the required URL (http/https/ftp with optional credentials), and url_password/url_username for basic auth.
questions: How do I pass a username and password to get_url?
What URL schemes does get_url support?
Can I use get_url with a username but no password?

answer_card.title: get_url url and credentials
answer_card.answer_md:
- `url` (required): `http`, `https`, or `ftp`, optionally `user:pass@`
- `url_username` (alias `username`): may be used alone for empty passwords
- `url_password` (alias `password`): only used with a username
- `unsafe_writes` (false)
